_about: Synthetic Telegram payloads for the SQLite schema tests. Each raw value is a Telethon 1.45 TL object serialized the way the collector stores it: to_dict(), then datetimes and bytes as str(). Every ID, access hash and file reference is small and invented, usernames end in _fx, and phone numbers use the 99966 test prefix. Entries with "telethon": false are hand-built. "expect" lists the generated column values the schema must derive from raw.
